description: Fix push notifications end-to-end: (1) Add projectId to getExpoPushTokenAsync call in mobile, (2) Send actual push notifications for individual Like/Save events (not just DB records), (3) Add EAS project configuration to app.json
steps: Step 1: Update mobile/app.json to add the 'extra.eas.projectId' field. Use a placeholder UUID that can be replaced with the real EAS project ID. The format should be: extra: { eas: { projectId: 'YOUR_EAS_PROJECT_ID' } }. Also add expo-constants to plugins if not present.
Step 2: Install expo-constants in mobile/package.json (add 'expo-constants': '~15.4.5' to dependencies) and run npm install in mobile/.

Step 3: Update mobile/src/services/pushNotification.service.ts to pass the projectId parameter to Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync(). Import Constants from 'expo-constants' and use Constants.expirationDate?.extra?.eas?.projectId. The correct call is: await Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({ projectId: Constants.expirationDate?.extra?.eas?.projectId ?? Constants.easConfig?.projectId }). Actually, for Expo SDK 50, the correct pattern is: const projectId = Constants?.expoConfig?.extra?.eas?.projectId; const tokenData = await Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({ projectId });

Step 4: Update backend/src/modules/notifications/notification.service.js createNotification() to send a push notification to the recipient. After creating the DB notification record, look up the recipient's pushTokens from the User model and call sendPushNotifications() with appropriate title/body based on notification type (e.g., 'New Like' / '{username} liked your post').

Step 5: Update backend/src/modules/posts/post.service.js addLike and addSave to pass the senderId info needed for push notification message personalization. The createNotification call already passes senderId - the notification service needs to look up sender username and recipient pushTokens.
Step 6: Verify syntax of all modified files with node --check (backend) and npx tsc --noEmit (mobile).
acceptance_criteria: expo-constants is listed in mobile/package.json dependencies
backend createNotification() sends actual push notifications to the recipient's device tokens for Like/Save/Follow events
All modified backend files pass node --check without errors
Mobile TypeScript compiles without errors (npx tsc --noEmit in mobile/)
verification: Verify projectId is passed in pushNotification.service.ts by reading the file
findings: npm install cannot run due to network restrictions (Repository access only mode). expo-constants added to package.json but not installed. A custom type stub was created at mobile/types/expo-constants/index.d.ts and registered in tsconfig.json paths to allow TypeScript compilation without node_modules. All pre-existing TypeScript errors (35 total) remain unchanged - no new errors introduced. Backend files pass node --check cleanly. Step 5 (updating post.service.js) was not needed because createNotification already receives senderId and the notification service now looks up the sender username internally. Review fix: Added generic fallback body for unknown notification types.
